metadata.description: Real-time change comprehension, content-detector change flagging, and severity-ranked decision support for Claude Code.

plugins.name: full
plugins.description: Meta-plugin. One install pulls in all 4 Crow plugins via dependency resolution.

plugins.name: change-tracker
plugins.description: Tracks every file change with semantic diff compression and change classification.

plugins.name: trust-scorer
plugins.description: Stateless content-detector suite that flags risky changes (exposed secrets, gutted tests, weak crypto, wildcard CORS, debug-in-prod, reverts) with a severity.

plugins.name: decision-gate
plugins.description: Per-change review that surfaces detector-flagged changes with type-specific adversarial self-review questions.

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Session continuity graph for compaction survival. Preserves decision history and learned preferences.
